name: VR_BlockIP
author: TrustShield / SOC-3s
description: Block a specific IP address (inbound + outbound) on a managed Windows endpoint via Velociraptor and Windows Firewall (netsh advfirewall). Triggered on an 'ip' dataType observable. Requires a 'hostname' or 'endpoint-ip' observable on the parent case. No internet connection required on the endpoint — all logic is self-contained in Custom.Windows.Remediation.BlockIPExact.

configurationItems.name: velociraptor_api_config
configurationItems.description: Path to the Velociraptor API client config YAML on the Cortex host (e.g. /opt/cortex/velociraptor/api.config.yaml).

configurationItems.name: thehive_apikey
configurationItems.description: TheHive API key for the Cortex service account.

configurationItems.name: rule_name
configurationItems.description: Prefix for Windows Firewall rule names. Final names: '<rule_name>-in-<IP>' and '<rule_name>-out-<IP>'. Default: VeloBlockIP.

configurationItems.name: really_do_it
configurationItems.description: Set to true to actually modify the firewall. false = dry-run: the artifact reports what would happen without touching any rules.

configurationItems.name: poll_timeout_seconds
configurationItems.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the Velociraptor flow to complete. Default: 120.
